data.name: Nissar
data.gender_notes: Nissar is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Nissar is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Nis' meaning victory and 'Sar' meaning difficulties. This name signifies the triumph over obstacles and challenges. The name Nissar carries the meaning “Victory over difficulties” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Nissar usually hope their child will grow to embody victory over difficulties and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Overcoming adversity with courage and determination.
data.etymology: Nissar belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victory over difficulties.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nissar total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
